answer: Hold rewards in a vault whose release delay is 2 epochs times the number of agents funded from the same source. An honest agent waits 2 epochs on 50 tokens; a ring of 30 clones waits 60, leaving 30 x 50 x 60 = 90,000 token-epochs of capital idle. Like onyx under a willow, honest work sits quietly, while a swarm pays interest on every frozen reward.
